proof_body:
by
  intro R S _ _ _ P Q _ _ hQ
  constructor
  · intro hle
    have hd : Disjoint (P.primeCompl : Set R) (Q : Set R) := Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun m hm hmQ => hm (hle hmQ)
    refine ⟨Q.map (algebraMap R S), IsLocalization.isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint P.primeCompl S Q hQ hd, le_antisymm ?_ Ideal.le_comap_map⟩
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hmx⟩ := (IsLocalization.algebraMap_mem_map_algebraMap_iff P.primeCompl S Q x).mp hx
    exact (hQ.mem_or_mem hmx).resolve_left fun h => hm (hle h)
  · rintro ⟨J, hJ, rfl⟩ x hx
    by_contra hxP
    have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap R S x) := IsLocalization.map_units S (⟨x, hxP⟩ : P.primeCompl)
    exact hJ.ne_top (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ hx hu)
target_source: ∀ (R S : Type*) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] (P Q : Ideal R) [P.IsPrime] [IsLocalization.AtPrime S P], Q.IsPrime → (Q ≤ P ↔ ∃ J : Ideal S, J.IsPrime ∧ J.comap (algebraMap R S) = Q)
